name: Lucia Szabova
event: UFC Fight Night: Moicano vs. Nolan
summary: An unbeaten Slovakian (10-0 in our data; other outlets list 11-0 or 12-0) who signs with the UFC as Oktagon's two-division champion, the first woman to hold Oktagon titles at bantamweight and flyweight at once. Makes her debut at bantamweight; she finishes from mount and from the clinch, and has gone five rounds.

how_they_fight.Striking: Comes from Muay Thai and kickboxing (Cageside Press). Pressures and does damage in the clinch with knees and elbows: that is how she broke Leidiane Fernandes in rounds two and three before the finish (per LowKick MMA). Two first-round TKOs on top of that.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Trips and takedowns into mount, then ground strikes: both title-winning finishes (Bolander 2025, Fernandes 2026) were ground-and-pound from mount (Cageside Press). Four submission wins, two in R1, one in R2, one in R3.
how_they_fight.Defense: Never beaten. Took heavy shots in the first round against Fernandes before taking over (per a fan post quoted by LowKick MMA; treat as soft). We have no strike-by-strike data for her; the numbers in our brief are placeholders, not her stats.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Finishes early or grinds late: of seven stoppages, four came in R1 (Petkeviciute sub, Netza TKO, Faria sub, Bolander TKO), one in R2 and two in R3 (Gumienna sub at 4:38, Fernandes TKO at 2:12). Went the full 25 minutes to beat ex-UFC fighter Lucie Pudilova in August. Against Fernandes she outlasted an opponent who tired in R2. Never stopped.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Composed; has dealt with title fights, a rebooked opponent and a five-rounder. A two-and-a-half-year gap between July 2021 and March 2024 (reason not found).

patterns: Unbeaten; a -200 favourite or shorter in every fight with a line in our data

concerns: UFC debut; every pro fight has been in Oktagon

keys_to_beat: Keep her off the clinch and out of mount
Hit her early, before she settles into pressure
Make her deal with real takedown defense and scrambles

news.text: Reported signed by the UFC (her Oktagon promoter acknowledged it, per AgentMMA) and booked against Tainara Lisboa at bantamweight for Oct. 31; Ag Fight first reported the bout (MMA Sucka).
Retained the Oktagon bantamweight title with a five-round unanimous decision over Lucie Pudilova in Prague.
Won the vacant Oktagon flyweight title, TKO of Leidiane Fernandes from mount at 2:12 of R3, becoming a two-division champion.
